prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, early 30s goddess, amazoness physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad; a commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist; enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves; powerful, statuesque and imposing; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, shaggy layered chestnut brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a strapless straight bandeau top of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey about a hand tall across her bust, with a slim striped school tie knotted at its center front and hanging down a short way, her shoulders and arms bare, the front closed by a hidden zipper and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, her whole ribcage, midriff and stomach bare below it, and a micro pleated skirt of ultra-thin matte navy modal jersey with a thin white stripe along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the crisp pleats of the skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: standing just behind the foreground landmark, weight on one leg with the other leg crossed in front, one hand resting on her outer hip and the other arm hanging relaxed at her side, chin lifted, looking at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme amazoness silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in navy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.

Background: a real famous place photographed at true scale, Sydney Harbour with the Sydney Opera House's white sail-shaped roofs, the harbour bridge and ferries on the blue water placed in the foreground close to the camera at the bottom centre of the frame, rising only to the height of her waist and thighs, tiny tourists, tiny cars and tiny tour buses around its base at their real size appearing as small as ants; she is a colossal giant standing just behind and slightly to one side of the foreground landmark, so that it overlaps only part of her legs and clearly shows how much taller than it she is, her towering heels planted on the harbour promenade, a blue sky with thin clouds behind her, the whole place clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright natural daylight with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at knee height, the famous foreground landmark large at the bottom centre of the frame and she standing just behind it, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the real people, vehicles and trees around her ankles shown at their true size so her colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
